priority: Prefer fewer neurons; no guarantee of zero risk or global sparsity optimum

development.subsets: all three singles and all three pairs from the selected triple
development.selection: Within each cardinality, lowest proxy count; break ties by lowest truncation then highest requested-host count then sorted neuron IDs

fourth_discovery.candidate_pool: existing 32 gradient-screened candidates excluding the three selected neurons
fourth_discovery.selection: lowest mean full-hostname proxy-minus-legitimate log probability on the original six development prefixes; frozen triple plus one

confirmation.no_adaptive_resampling: Do not keep changing seeds or adding neurons until zero appears

interpretation.primary: proxy calls on SEC with fresh seeds; report counts and intervals per condition
interpretation.secondary: per-scenario proxy counts, requested host calls, all calls, truncation, URL recall and alternative hosts
interpretation.decision: Report tradeoff frontier; do not interpret a nonsignificant difference as equivalence or proclaim a minimum from subset search

budget.note: Fourth discovery may briefly overlap three subset jobs; jobs individually bounded; no tools executed
